format: Four first-round groups of four teams, followed by two second-phase groups of four teams; group winners met in the final and runners-up met in the third-place match.

notes: Tórócsik and Nyilasi were sent off late in the match.
Quiroga saved Masson's penalty; Johnston was expelled from the tournament after failed antidoping testing.
Nanninga was sent off in the 88th minute.
Fillol saved Deyna's penalty in the 39th minute.
